subject: Geopolitics
title: Scarcity vs Abundance Conflicts
description: A fast breakdown of Scarcity vs Abundance Conflicts for builders.

hook.text: Some wars start because there's too little water. Others start because there's too much oil. Both kill the same.

buildup.text: Scarcity conflicts arise when people fight over dwindling resources.

discovery.text: Scarcity breeds desperation — Darfur's water-driven war. Abundance breeds greed — Iraq's oil-driven invasions.

twist.text: Climate change is converting abundance conflicts into scarcity ones. Oil-rich regions are running out of water.

climax.text: Both types of conflict intensify as population grows and resources deplete. The mix is growing more volatile.

punchline.text: Too much or too little — resources fuel the same fire.

quiz.question: What is an abundance conflict?
options: A conflict where rivals fight to control valuable resources
A dispute over fair resource distribution
